featured.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 团队
featured.summaryEn: Sottiaux from OpenAI's Codex/ChatGPT team shared three notable points this week. First, a clarification: the 80% GPT-5.6 Luna price cut is permanent, not a stunt — "efficiency gains don't go away." Second, a sober read on today's coding agents: Codex is a good harness now, but "it will seem primitive in 2-3 months" as the frontier evolves — the next generation of models "need more than your laptop," hinting at a shift toward heavier, cloud-scale compute. Third, the OpenAI-insider flex: open your laptop, "codex a P…
featured.insightZh: OpenAI Codex/ChatGPT 团队的 Thibault Sottiaux 这周有三条值得看。首先他澄清了一个误解：GPT-5.6 Luna 那次 80% 的降价不是临时噱头，而是永久的——「效率提升不会倒退回去」。其次他对当前 coding agent 的形态给了个清醒判断：Codex 现在确实是个好 harness，但两三个月后回头看会显得很原始，前沿模型的下一代「需要的不只是你那台笔记本」，暗示算力和运行环境会往云端和更大规模走。最后一句挺能代表 OpenAI 内部的爽感：打开笔记本，用 Codex「凭空 codex 出一个 PR」，直接给 10 亿用户 ship 一个改进。

featured.title: Peter Yang · Practical AI 教程与访谈创作者
featured.summaryEn: Peter Yang's highlight this week was his interview with Nous Research co-founder Karan on what actually makes a personal AI agent work. His biggest takeaway is counterintuitive: the "personal" in personal agent isn't the model — it's the agent's memory of your conversations and the skills you've built with it. Karan says he barely notices when he swaps out the underlying model, because the value lives in memory and skills, not weights. A direct read-across for enterprise AI strategy: the moat is accumulated data a…
featured.insightZh: Peter Yang 这周的重点是他对 Nous Research 联合创始人 Karan 的访谈，主题是「个人 AI agent 到底靠什么」。他的最大 takeaway 很反直觉：personal agent 里「personal」的部分不是模型本身——而是 agent 对你历次对话的记忆，以及你和它一起搭起来的技能。Karan 说他换底层模型时几乎没感觉，因为价值沉淀在 memory 和 skills 里，不在权重里。这条线索对企业 AI 战略有直接启发：真正的护城河在数据与工作流沉淀，而非绑定某一个模型。他还引用 Karan 的一句话点出开源信仰：「我们就是想让开源最终赢，想让自由降临到每个人身上。」

featured.title: AI Vibe Check：中国开源模型、蒸馏与 Hugging Face 入侵事件
featured.summaryEn: China's open-weight models are formidable, but still ~3-4 months behind the true frontier; the "it's all distillation" narrative is overstated; and OpenAI's agent breaching Hugging Face is itself an argument for why strong open models matter for attack/defense symmetry. In this Unsupervised Learning episode, host Jacob Efron and recurring guests Ari Marcos (Datalogy) and Rob Toews (Radical Ventures) unpack the recent AI ecosystem. On Chinese open models, Ari's prediction that "the world's best open model would come from China" is playing out and will continue — but licenses are tightening (Kimi k3 added a revenue gate), and he expects more "open weights with a revenue gate." Rob adds a sober correction: k3 is somewhat oversold and isn't truly SOTA in most senses; China's open frontier is at least a few months behind the real US frontier — though he concedes that "how far behind" matters…
featured.insightZh: 中国开源权重模型确实凶猛，但离真正的前沿仍有 3-4 个月差距；「蒸馏论」被高估了；而 OpenAI agent 攻破 Hugging Face 这件事，恰恰说明为什么足够强的开源模型对「攻防对称」很重要。 这期 Unsupervised Learning 由主持人 Jacob Efron 与常驻嘉宾 Ari Marcos（Datalogy）、Rob Toews（Radical Ventures）三人复盘近期 AI 生态。关于中国开源模型，Ari 认为「世界最强开源模型来自中国」的预言正在兑现，且趋势会延续，但许可证在收紧——比如 Kimi k3 加了营收门槛（超过一定年/月营收就需商业授权），预计这种「带营收 gate 的开源」会越来越多。Rob 则给了个冷静的修正：k3 被吹得有点过，它在多数意义上并非真正 SOTA，中国开源前沿至少还落后美国真实前沿几个月；但他也承认「离前沿多远」在战略上很重要，尤其若递归自我改进成立，这种优势会复利放大。 关于「蒸馏是不是中国模型追上来的唯一原因」，Ari 的判断是：蒸馏有真实且非零的价值（尤其蒸馏推理轨迹），但远不足以解释全部，把中国模型说成只是「白嫖美国」有点站不住脚——何况早期美国前沿模型也用了大量非授权数据训练，某种意义上是「蒸馏了所有人」，如今反过来喊「没人能蒸馏我」有点双标。Rob 补充：只要还有模型通过 API 公开可用，蒸馏本质上无法阻止，除非前沿实验室彻底关掉公开 API。 关于开源之争与 Anthropic 的处境：三人观察到舆论正在把 Anthropic 塑造成「反开源的坏人」——它是唯一没签那封开源公开信的公司。但 Rob 认为 Anthropic 的立场比舆论呈现的更站得住：它并不反对开源权重模型本身（Dario 也专门撰文澄清），真正的分歧在于「来自中国的、过于强大的开源模型」是否应该存在，以及美国企业乃至全球用户在多大程度上应把 Chinese tech stack 作为 AI 底座。Ari 则反驳这个「太强就不该开源」的论点，并借 Hugging Face 事件点出攻防不对称：如果只有极少数人能…

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie offered a vivid read on yet another "near-frontier open weights" release this week: if you'd gone back even 3-6 months and given everyone access to today's open-weights capabilities — even as a closed model — minds would be "completely blown." And it's now routine: "another day, another near frontier open weights model release." His point: this fundamentally changes the enterprise buying calculus — when capable-enough intelligence is free via open weights, many use cases no longer justify payin…
items.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 对本周又一个「近前沿开源权重模型」发布下了个很有画面感的判断：如果把我们现在看到的开源权重能力放回 3-6 个月前、哪怕作为闭源模型交给所有人，都会让人「彻底震惊」。而这已经变成了常态——「每天一个近前沿开源模型」。他的落点是这从根本上改变了企业的采购算式：当足够强的能力以开源权重免费可得时，很多场景不再需要为最前沿闭源模型付溢价。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq from Anthropic's Claude Code team flagged a practical detail many miss: if you connect a Claude Connector (Gmail, calendar, Slack, etc.), Claude Code can use those connections too — including inside Artifacts. In other words, personal-assistant-grade connectors aren't just for conversational Claude; the whole agent tool chain shares them. For teams pushing Claude into enterprise collaboration flows, that means connect once, reuse everywhere.
items.insightZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队的 Thariq 抛出一个很多人还没意识到的落地细节：如果你给 Claude 连上了 Connector（比如 Gmail、日历、Slack），那么 Claude Code 也能直接调用这些连接——包括在 Artifacts 里。也就是说，个人助理级的连接器不是只服务对话式 Claude，而是整条 agent 工具链共享。对于想把 Claude 铺进企业协作流的团队，这意味着一次连接、多处复用。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Replit CEO Amjad Masad shared an internal data-infra play: they built a "self-driving and self-correcting shared semantic layer" on top of their databases, conversations, and docs. The key win — everything is queryable and joinable regardless of source. The result: anyone at Replit can now ask questions that previously took a team of data scientists weeks to answer. A clean example of "semantic layer + agent" democratizing internal data — worth a look for anyone building enterprise data platforms.
items.insightZh: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 分享了一个内部数据基建的实践：他们在数据库、对话和文档之上搭了一个「自动驾驶、自我纠错的共享语义层」。核心价值是——不管数据来自哪个源，都可以统一查询和 join。结果是 Replit 里任何人现在都能直接提问，而这些问题以前需要一个数据科学家团队花几周才能回答。这是一个「semantic layer + agent」把内部数据民主化的典型样本，值得做企业数据平台的团队参考。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Two things from Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch this week. First, a new acronym to succeed classic PLG (product-led growth): ALG — Agent-Led Growth. The logic: have agents adopt your product first, then do the meetings if needed; companies that start with meetings likely aren't your ideal customers. It crystallizes the "agent as the new user/buyer" lens on growth. Second, a preview of Next.js 16.3: faster dev and builds, an incremental `next build` cache, and instant navigations on by default — bringing SPA-like feel b…
items.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 这周有两条。一是他提出了一个新缩写来替代经典的 PLG（产品驱动增长）：ALG——Agent-Led Growth。逻辑是让 agent 先采用你的产品，再去谈会议（如果还需要的话）；那些「从会议开始」的公司往往不是你的理想客户。这是把「agent 作为新一代用户/买家」的产品增长视角明确化。二是他预告 Next.js 16.3：更快的 dev 和 build、增量式 `next build` 缓存、以及默认开启的即时导航（instant navigations），把 SPA 般的体验带回多页应用。

items.title: Swyx · smol.ai 创始人
items.summaryEn: Swyx (smol.ai) raised an increasingly real question this week: do we even need captchas anymore when bots can clearly clear them? He threaded together a series of "CUA (computer-use agent) wow moments," with this one focused on captchas as a failing line of defense — computer-use agents drive browsers like humans and pass challenges, hollowing out captcha's role of telling humans from machines. For teams working on identity, fraud, and anti-bot, it's a signal to rethink the trust layer.
items.insightZh: Swyx（smol.ai）这周抛出一个越来越现实的问题：当 bot 已经能明显地清掉验证码时，我们还需要 captcha 吗？他把一串「CUA（computer-use agent）惊艳时刻」串成了主线，其中这条专门聚焦在验证码这道防线正在失效——computer-use agent 能像人一样操作浏览器、通过人机验证，captcha 作为「区分人和机器」的机制正被架空。对做身份、风控、反爬的团队，这是一个需要重新设计信任层的信号。

items.title: Amanda Askell · Anthropic 哲学家/伦理学家
items.summaryEn: Anthropic philosopher/ethicist Amanda Askell offered a quotable nuance on AI alignment. She rejects the binary that model behavior is either aligned or harmful: models (like humans) can behave in aligned ways while still causing harm — e.g., because they're given false information about their situation. Her core point: aligned and harmless aren't two ends of one line, they're different axes. A useful reminder for anyone doing AI safety evals — testing "does it comply" is not the same as testing "is it harmless."
items.insightZh: Anthropic 的哲学家兼伦理学家 Amanda Askell 就 AI 对齐给了个很值得引用的细分观点。她不同意「模型行为要么对齐、要么有害」这种二分：她认为模型（和人一样）完全可以在「行为对齐」的同时仍然造成伤害——比如因为被给了关于自身处境的错误信息。她的核心论点是：aligned 和 harmless 不是一条线的两端，而是两个不同的维度。这对做 AI 安全评估的人是个提醒——只测「是否听话」不等于测「是否无害」。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder / Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Follow Builders author Zara Zhang shared a simple but effective Codex use case: trip planning. The move — take screenshots of your restaurant, train, and event bookings, and ask Codex to put them on your Google Calendar. It's a lightweight "multimodal screenshot → structured schedule" agent workflow, near-zero prompt engineering, usable by anyone right away.
items.insightZh: Follow Builders 的作者 Zara Zhang 分享了一个简单但很实用的 Codex 用法：出行规划。做法是把餐厅、火车、活动的预订截图丢给 Codex，让它直接把这些安排填进你的 Google Calendar。这是「多模态截图 → 结构化日程」的轻量 agent workflow，几乎零 prompt 工程，普通人立刻能用。

items.title: 关于近期 Claude Code 质量反馈的复盘
items.summaryEn: Anthropic Engineering published a candid postmortem addressing a month of "Claude got worse" reports. They traced it to three independent changes hitting different traffic slices on different schedules — which in aggregate looked like broad, inconsistent degradation, though the API was never affected. The three bugs: on March 4, lowering Claude Code's default reasoning effort from high to medium (the wrong tradeoff, reverted April 7); on March 26, a change to clear idle-session thinking that buggily fired every turn, making Claude seem forgetful and repetitive (fixed April 10); on April 16, a "reduce verbosity" system-prompt instruction that, combined with other prompt changes, hurt coding quality (reverted April 20). All resolved in v2.1.116 (April 20), with usage limits reset for all subscribers. Worth reading for any LLM product team — a case study in how small prompt/harness changes…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 工程团队发了一篇很坦诚的事后复盘，回应过去一个月「Claude 回答变差了」的用户反馈。他们把问题追溯到三个各自独立、影响不同流量切片、时间表也不同的改动，结果叠加起来看就像是「大范围、不一致的降级」——但 API 层始终未受影响。三个 bug 分别是：3 月 4 日把 Claude Code 默认 reasoning effort 从 high 降到 medium（为减少高延迟，但被证明是错误权衡，4 月 7 日回滚）；3 月 26 日一个清理闲置会话旧思考的改动出了 bug，导致每一轮都清理、让 Claude 显得健忘重复（4 月 10 日修复）；4 月 16 日一条「减少啰嗦」的 system prompt 指令连同其他 prompt 改动损害了 coding 质量（4 月 20 日回滚）。全部已在 v2.1.116（4 月 20 日）解决，并为所有订阅用户重置用量限额。值得所有做 LLM 产品的团队读——它示范了「prompt/harness 层的小改动如何造成看似模型退化的体验」，以及为什么可复现的 eval 这么难。

items.title: 扩展 Managed Agents：把「大脑」和「双手」解耦
items.summaryEn: Anthropic explains how they built Managed Agents (a hosted service on the Claude Platform that runs long-horizon agents for you) as an architecture meant to outlast any particular implementation. The key insight borrows from operating systems: decades ago, OSes virtualized hardware into abstractions general enough for "programs as yet unthought of" — `read()` doesn't care if it's a 1970s disk pack or a modern SSD; the abstraction stays stable while implementations swap freely. Managed Agents does the same, virtualizing an agent into three parts: a session (append-only log of everything), a harness (the loop calling Claude and routing tool calls), and a sandbox (the execution environment). Each can be swapped without disturbing the others. They also share a hard-won lesson: putting all three in a single container meant "adopting a pet" — if the container died, the session was lost, and d…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 讲了他们如何把 Managed Agents（在 Claude Platform 上代客运行长周期 agent 的托管服务）做成一个能「活得比任何具体实现更久」的架构。核心洞察借鉴了操作系统：几十年前 OS 通过把硬件虚拟化成 process、file 这些足够通用的抽象，让「尚未被想到的程序」也能跑——`read()` 不在乎你读的是 1970 年代的磁盘还是现代 SSD，抽象稳定、底层实现自由更替。Managed Agents 照搬这个思路，把 agent 虚拟化成三件套：session（记录一切发生事项的 append-only 日志）、harness（调用 Claude 并把工具调用路由到基础设施的循环）、sandbox（Claude 跑代码改文件的执行环境），三者可各自替换互不干扰。文章还讲了他们踩过的坑：最初把三件套塞进单个容器，结果「养了个宠物」——容器一挂 session 就丢，调试时还常常混着用户数据，几乎无法排障。这篇对任何设计长周期 agent 基础设施的团队都极有参考价值。

items.title: Managed Agents 新增：自托管 sandbox 与 MCP tunnels
items.summaryEn: The Claude blog announces Managed Agents can now run in a sandbox you control and connect to your private MCP servers — all within your enterprise's existing security and runtime boundaries. Self-hosted sandboxes move tool execution onto infrastructure you control (or providers like Cloudflare, Daytona, Modal, Vercel), so code execution, sensitive files, packages, services, and data stay inside your perimeter — while the agent loop (orchestration, context management, error recovery) stays on Anthropic's side, echoing the "decouple brain from hands" architecture. The four providers each bring a flavor: Cloudflare (microVMs + zero-trust secret injection, auditable egress); Daytona (long-running, stateful, SSH-accessible "full composable computers"); Modal (sub-second startup, scales to hundreds of thousands of concurrent sandboxes, on-demand CPU/GPU); Vercel (VM security, VPC peering, mil…
items.insightZh: Claude 官方博客宣布 Managed Agents 现在可以在「你自己控制的 sandbox」里运行，并连接到你的私有 MCP 服务器——都在企业既有的安全与运行时边界内。自托管 sandbox 让 agent 的工具执行发生在你控制的基础设施上（或 Cloudflare、Daytona、Modal、Vercel 等托管方），代码执行、敏感文件、依赖包、服务和数据都留在企业边界内；而负责编排、上下文管理、错误恢复的 agent loop 仍跑在 Anthropic 侧——正好呼应了上一篇「大脑与双手解耦」的架构。四家 sandbox 提供商各有侧重：Cloudflare 用 microVM + 零信任密钥注入、可审计 egress；Daytona 是可长时运行、有状态、可 SSH 接入的「完整可组合计算机」；Modal 主打亚秒级启动、可扩到数十万并发、按需 CPU/GPU；Vercel 结合 VM 安全、VPC peering 和毫秒级启动，在网络边界注入凭据、绝不进入 sandbox。目前自托管 sandbox 公测、MCP tunnels 处于 research preview。对有数据主权/合规要求（如金融、生命科学）的企业客户，这是把 agent 真正搬进自己边界的关键一步。
